Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: Lifelong Robot Library Learning: Bootstrapping Composable and Generalizable Skills for Embodied Control with Language Models
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该文切中当前LLM具身控制领域'固定技能库+提示工程'的静态局限性痛点。其核心亮点在于放弃了主流的梯度微调路线，转而利用LLM的逻辑推理能力进行'技能抽象'，构建显式、可解释的技能库，巧妙规避了灾难性遗忘。然而，该方法对仿真环境保真度和LLM代码生成准确性的依赖极高，'自引导探索'生成的任务质量将直接决定技能库的有效性与收敛效率，存在语义漂移风险。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: Lifelong Robot Library Learning: Bootstrapping Composable and Generalizable Skills for Embodied Control with Language Models 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Georgios Tziafas, Hamidreza Kasaei 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-06-26 20:25:30 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.18746v2 🧾 一句话总结： 突破LLM机器人控制静态库限制，构建记忆与技能抽象闭环，实现无需梯度优化的可组合、可泛化的终身技能学习。 📄 摘要： Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a new paradigm for embodied reasoning and control, most recently by generating robot policy code that utilizes a custom library of vision and control primitive skills. However, prior arts fix their skills library and steer the LLM with carefully hand-crafted prompt engineering, limiting the agent to a stationary range of addressable tasks. In this work, we introduce LRLL, an LLM-based lifelong learning agent that continuously grows the robot skill library to tackle manipulation tasks of ever-growing complexity. LRLL achieves this with four novel contributions: 1) a soft memory module that allows dynamic storage and retrieval of past experiences to serve as context, 2) a self-guided exploration policy that proposes new tasks in simulation, 3) a skill abstractor that distills recent experiences into new library skills, and 4) a lifelong learning algorithm for enabling human users to bootstrap new skills with minimal online interaction. LRLL continuously transfers knowledge from the memory to the library, building composable, general and interpretable policies, while bypassing gradient-based optimization, thus relieving the learner from catastrophic forgetting. Empirical evaluation in a simulated tabletop environment shows that LRLL outperforms end-to-end and vanilla LLM approaches in the lifelong setup while learning skills that are transferable to the real world. Project material will become available at the webpage https://gtziafas.github.io/LRLL_project. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Lifelong Robot Library Learning (LRLL)]] [[Soft Memory Module]] [[Skill Abstractor]] [[Self-guided Exploration]] [[Composable Skills]] [[Non-gradient Optimization]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出LRLL框架，通过软记忆模块动态存取经验作为上下文，利用自引导探索策略在仿真中提议新任务，经由技能抽象器将近期经验提炼为可组合的库技能，采用非梯度优化的方式实现知识从记忆到技能库的持续迁移，以此规避灾难性遗忘。 💬 锐评 该文切中当前LLM具身控制领域'固定技能库+提示工程'的静态局限性痛点。其核心亮点在于放弃了主流的梯度微调路线，转而利用LLM的逻辑推理能力进行'技能抽象'，构建显式、可解释的技能库，巧妙规避了灾难性遗忘。然而，该方法对仿真环境保真度和LLM代码生成准确性的依赖极高，'自引导探索'生成的任务质量将直接决定技能库的有效性与收敛效率，存在语义漂移风险。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: MechGeo: Autoformalizing and Proving Euclidean Geometry in Lean 4
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该方法巧妙避开了端到端LLM翻译的不稳定性，引入GeoIR作为结构化桥梁，并通过“反例构造-诊断-修复”机制实现了形式化正确性的闭环验证。虽然宣称解决IMO难题，但在14个反例案例中仍依赖专家修正，说明其全自动闭环能力仍有边界；此外摘要提及IMO 2026题目颇为超前（或为特定未来数据集设定），体现了该工作在前沿探索上的激进姿态。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: MechGeo: Autoformalizing and Proving Euclidean Geometry in Lean 4 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Hao Shen, Junyu Guo, Tian Cui, Yuxuan Xiao, Lihong Zhi 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 14:24:12 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02295v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过引入GeoIR中间表示与反例引导修复机制，首次在Lean 4中实现了大规模IMO几何题的自动化形式化与认证证明，为可信几何推理建立了实用基线。 📄 摘要： We present MechGeo, a Mathlib native agentic framework that jointly addresses faithful autoformalization and certified proof construction for Euclidean geometry. In this framework, GeoFormalizer represents informal problems in GeoIR, deterministically translates them into Lean 4, and iteratively repairs candidate statements using structural diagnostics and semantic evaluation. GeoProver constructs geometric proof plans, derives intermediate lemmas, and selectively algebraizes suitable subgoals through a library verified in Lean. Singular or SymPy may generate algebraic certificates, but all resulting proofs and counterexamples are checked by Lean's kernel. Experiments across seven LLM backbones show substantial improvements in autoformalization, particularly for models with weaker direct translation performance. On 43 historical IMO geometry problems, GeoFormalizer generates formal statements that GeoProver proves in 29 cases; for the remaining 14, it constructs counterexamples verified in Lean and proves all repaired statements after expert correction. Together with IMO 2026 Problem 2, this yields, to the best of our knowledge, the largest reported collection of automated, kernel-checked Lean proofs for IMO geometry problems. On the 14 geometry statements in LEAP's Lean-IMO-Bench, MechGeo proves 12 for the first time, formally refutes the remaining two, and proves both repaired statements. These results establish counterexample guided diagnosis, geometric reasoning, and certified symbolic computation as a practical foundation for trustworthy formal geometry. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Autoformalization]] [[Lean 4]] [[GeoIR]] [[Counterexample-guided Diagnosis]] [[Certified Symbolic Computation]] 🔬 核心方法简述 构建了Mathlib原生的Agent框架：首先将非形式化问题转化为GeoIR中间表示并转译为Lean 4，利用反例引导的诊断循环进行迭代修复；随后GeoProver结合几何推理与认证的符号计算（Singular/SymPy），生成经Lean内核检验的严格证明。 💬 锐评 该方法巧妙避开了端到端LLM翻译的不稳定性，引入GeoIR作为结构化桥梁，并通过“反例构造-诊断-修复”机制实现了形式化正确性的闭环验证。虽然宣称解决IMO难题，但在14个反例案例中仍依赖专家修正，说明其全自动闭环能力仍有边界；此外摘要提及IMO 2026题目颇为超前（或为特定未来数据集设定），体现了该工作在前沿探索上的激进姿态。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: From Profiling to Synthesis: Benchmarking Implicit Behavioral Alignment in Personalized LLM Agents
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该研究精准定位了个性化代理的痛点——从静态配置到动态演进的鸿沟。通过引入噪声和隐式线索，不仅提升了基准的挑战性，更提出了针对性的IBA-Agent框架。这种数据特征驱动模型架构设计的思路，为冷启动阶段的个性化研究提供了极具深度的范式参考。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: From Profiling to Synthesis: Benchmarking Implicit Behavioral Alignment in Personalized LLM Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Jiajia Song, Bobo Li, Haiwen Yi, Zibo Ji, Meishan Zhang, Hao Fei, Min Zhang, Mong-Li Lee, Wynne Hsu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 12:52:04 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02171v1 🧾 一句话总结： 构建了包含噪声与隐式线索的纵向交互基准IBA-Bench，并提出IBA-Agent框架以弥合个性化代理中的知识-行动鸿沟。 📄 摘要： Large Language Models have enabled increasingly capable autonomous agents, yet personalization remains critical for making such agents practically useful. Recent benchmarks have begun evaluating personalization in agents, but they largely rely on static preference snapshots, fixed interaction logs, or question answering over predefined user profiles. Such designs fail to capture the complexity of evolving user preferences and neglect preference-conditioned task execution-a discrepancy we term as the knowledge-to-action gap. To address this challenge, we introduce IBA-Bench, a benchmark for implicit behavioral alignment constructed from longitudinal interaction histories that contain noise, implicit cues, and temporal inconsistencies. Unlike prior work, IBA-Bench evaluates whether an agent can execute tasks while satisfying implicit user constraints inferred from historical interactions. We further propose IBA-Agent, an agent framework that reconciles conflicting priorities through broad retrieval and trajectory-level alignment. Experiment results on IBA-Bench show that effective personalization remains a significant challenge for state-of-the-art LLM agents, and the proposed IBA-Agent substantially improves behavioral alignment in complex scenarios across nine application domains. 🧠 核心术语库 [[IBA-Bench]] [[IBA-Agent]] [[知识-行动鸿沟]] [[隐性行为对齐]] [[纵向交互历史]] [[轨迹级对齐]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出IBA-Bench基准，利用包含噪声、隐式线索和时序不一致的纵向交互历史进行评估；提出IBA-Agent框架，通过广泛检索和轨迹级对齐来调和冲突的优先级，以填补知识到行动的鸿沟。 💬 锐评 该研究精准定位了个性化代理的痛点——从静态配置到动态演进的鸿沟。通过引入噪声和隐式线索，不仅提升了基准的挑战性，更提出了针对性的IBA-Agent框架。这种数据特征驱动模型架构设计的思路，为冷启动阶段的个性化研究提供了极具深度的范式参考。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: SkillAxe: Sharpening LLM-Authored Agent Skills Through Evaluation-Guided Self-Refinement
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: SkillAxe的创新性在于无需标注数据的自我改进机制，但维度划分的全面性和有效性可能受限于当前LLM能力，且未明确说明迭代次数和收敛条件。此外，技能库在真实场景中的泛化能力有待验证。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: SkillAxe: Sharpening LLM-Authored Agent Skills Through Evaluation-Guided Self-Refinement 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Srishti Gautam, Arjun Radhakrishna, Sumit Gulwani 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-06-09 08:14:39 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10546v2 🧾 一句话总结： SkillAxe通过无监督评估-改进循环显著提升LLM技能质量，缩短了与人类作者的差距，并在真实场景中实现性能飞跃。 📄 摘要： Skill documents, structured natural-language instructions that guide Large Language Model (LLM) agents, are critical to modern agent frameworks, yet LLMs struggle to write skills that actually work. On SkillsBench, human-authored skills improve pass rates by 16.2 percentage points, while LLM-authored skills provide no measurable gain. We introduce SkillAxe, a fully unsupervised framework that enables LLMs to iteratively diagnose and refine their own skills. SkillAxe decomposes skill quality into four interpretable dimensions (quality impact, trigger precision, instruction compliance with fault attribution, and solution-path coverage), producing structured improvement briefs that require no ground-truth labels, test suites, or environment rewards. On SkillsBench, SkillAxe improves pass rates by 28\% relative over unimproved LLM skills and closes 47--67\% of the gap to human-authored skills. We validate the approach as a continuous improvement engine in the wild on SpreadsheetBench, where a SkillAxe-built skill library learns from past agent trajectories and raises pass rate from 16.0\% to 52.0\% using only 22 skills. 🧠 核心术语库 [[SkillAxe]] [[技能质量维度]] [[自我评估]] [[迭代改进]] [[SkillsBench]] [[SpreadsheetBench]] 🔬 核心方法简述 SkillAxe采用无监督框架，通过自我评估和迭代改进提升LLM技能质量。具体步骤包括：1) 将技能质量分解为四个维度（质量影响、触发精度、指令合规性、解决方案覆盖率）；2) 生成无需标注的结构化改进简报；3) 通过迭代优化提升技能表现。 💬 锐评 SkillAxe的创新性在于无需标注数据的自我改进机制，但维度划分的全面性和有效性可能受限于当前LLM能力，且未明确说明迭代次数和收敛条件。此外，技能库在真实场景中的泛化能力有待验证。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: When Search Becomes Memory: Turning Robot Design Trials into Transferable Skills
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 创新性地将LLM的生成能力与进化算法结合，但依赖大规模计算资源且技能库的泛化能力需进一步验证；未明确解决技能表述的歧义性问题，可能影响实际工程应用。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: When Search Becomes Memory: Turning Robot Design Trials into Transferable Skills 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读/值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Yunfei Wang, Xiaohao Xu, Yang Li, Xiaonan Huang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-05-25 13:29:45 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25832v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过显式存储设计经验构建可迁移的技能库，显著提升机器人设计的冷启动效率与跨空间迁移性能。 📄 摘要： Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as proposal generators for evolutionary robot design, yet most loops remain memoryless: simulator results shape the next population but are not preserved as reusable design knowledge. We present Auto-Robotist, a self-evolving LLM agent that distills morphology-search traces into an explicit natural-language skill library. Each skill stores a structural archetype, evidence-grounded positive and negative rules, and the evaluated designs that support them, making design memory inspectable rather than implicit in a population. During search, the agent retrieves skills to condition LLM edits of elite bodies while retaining a Genetic Algorithm (GA) mutation path for exploration; after evaluation, it updates the library through Add, Diagnose, and Merge. Across seven EvoGym tasks spanning locomotion, traversal, and object interaction, Auto-Robotist improves cold-start 5x5 search and transfers learned skills to 10x10 design spaces, where reference-conditioned transfer outperforms GA on every task. These results suggest that LLM agents can convert expensive physical evaluations into reusable, auditable design principles. Our code will be released upon acceptance. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Auto-Robotist]] [[技能库（Skill Library）]] [[形态搜索（Morphology Search）]] [[遗传算法（GA）]] [[冷启动优化（Cold-start Optimization）]] [[跨任务迁移（Transfer Learning）]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出Auto-Robotist框架，通过LLM生成机器人设计提案并结合遗传算法优化，将搜索过程中的形态演化轨迹转化为可检索的自然语言技能库。技能库包含结构原型、证据驱动的规则及验证设计，通过Add/Diagnose/Merge机制动态更新，实现设计知识的显式存储与跨任务迁移。 💬 锐评 创新性地将LLM的生成能力与进化算法结合，但依赖大规模计算资源且技能库的泛化能力需进一步验证；未明确解决技能表述的歧义性问题，可能影响实际工程应用。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: SkillOps: Managing LLM Agent Skill Libraries as Self-Maintaining Software Ecosystems
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 论文核心贡献在于提出技能库维护这一被忽视的问题，但存在几个局限：1)实验仅在ALFWorld单一环境评估，泛化性存疑；2)四维诊断指标的具体计算规则未充分展开；3)规则-based维护的覆盖度和适应性边界不清晰；4)与现有检索/规划agent的兼容性声称缺乏消融实验验证。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: SkillOps: Managing LLM Agent Skill Libraries as Self-Maintaining Software Ecosystems 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Hongji Pu, Xinyuan Song, Liang Zhao 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-05-13 16:02:25 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13716v1 🧾 一句话总结： 首次系统化提出LLM agent技能库的技术债务问题及维护框架，通过技能契约建模和四维健康诊断实现低开销的库时维护，在ALFWorld上验证了有效性，为技能库运维提供了新思路。 📄 摘要： Large language model agents increasingly rely on skill libraries for multi-step tasks, yet these libraries can accumulate persistent defects as skills are added, reused, patched, and linked to changing dependencies. We call this failure mode skill technical debt: library-level defects that may not break a single skill locally but can harm future retrieval, composition, and execution. Existing skill-based agents mainly focus on task-time retrieval, planning, and repair, while library-time maintenance remains underexplored. We propose SkillOps, a method-agnostic plug-in framework for maintaining skill libraries. SkillOps represents each skill as a typed Skill Contract (P, O, A, V, F), organizes skills with a Hierarchical Skill Ecosystem Graph, and diagnoses library health across utility, compatibility, risk, and validation dimensions. Given a raw skill library, SkillOps produces a maintained library that can be used by existing retrieval or planning agents without changing their internal code. On ALFWorld, SkillOps achieves 79.5 percent task success as a standalone agent, outperforming the strongest baseline by 8.8 percentage points with no additional task-time large language model calls. As a plug-in layer, it improves retrieval-heavy baselines by 0.68 to 2.90 percentage points. The current rule-based maintenance implementation uses nearly zero library-time large language model calls or tokens, showing that skill-library maintenance can be added as a low-overhead architectural layer. 🧠 核心术语库 [[技能技术债务(Skill Technical Debt)]] [[技能契约(Skill Contract)]] [[层次技能生态系统图(Hierarchical Skill Ecosystem Graph)]] [[库健康诊断(Library Health Diagnosis)]] [[自维护软件生态系统(Self-Maintaining Software Ecosystem)]] 🔬 核心方法简述 SkillOps将每个技能建模为类型化技能契约(P参数 、O输出、A动作、V验证、F前置条件)，构建层次技能生态系统图组织技能库，从utility、compatibility、risk、validation四个维度诊断库健康状况。维护实现采用规则驱动，接近零库时LLM调用。 💬 锐评 论文核心贡献在于提出技能库维护这一被忽视的问题，但存在几个局限：1)实验仅在ALFWorld单一环境评估，泛化性存疑；2)四维诊断指标的具体计算规则未充分展开；3)规则-based维护的覆盖度和适应性边界不清晰；4)与现有检索/规划agent的兼容性声称缺乏消融实验验证。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: SkillX: Automatically Constructing Skill Knowledge Bases for Agents
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 将经验显式表示为层次化技能库并跨模型复用的思路具有较高的工程落地价值，但“探索性技能扩展”若无严格的边界控制与验证机制，极易引入幻觉技能导致库污染。此外，高度依赖单一强模型(GLM-4.6)作为技能源，技能库的质量上限会被该模型的能力天花板锁死，且面对分布外(OOD)极端环境时的泛化可靠性仍需打问号。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: SkillX: Automatically Constructing Skill Knowledge Bases for Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Chenxi Wang, Zhuoyun Yu, Xin Xie, Wuguannan Yao, Runnan Fang, Shuofei Qiao, Kexin Cao, Guozhou Zheng, Xiang Qi, Peng Zhang, Shumin Deng 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-04-06 16:09:33 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04804v2 🧾 一句话总结： SkillX提出了一种自动化构建三层架构即插即用技能库的框架，通过轨迹蒸馏、迭代优化与探索扩展实现了Agent经验的高效复用与弱模型赋能。 📄 摘要： Learning from experience is critical for building capable large language model (LLM) agents, yet prevailing self-evolving paradigms remain inefficient: agents learn in isolation, repeatedly rediscover similar behaviors from limited experience, resulting in redundant exploration and poor generalization. To address this problem, we propose SkillX, a fully automated framework for constructing a \textbf{plug-and-play skill knowledge base} that can be reused across agents and environments. SkillX operates through a fully automated pipeline built on three synergistic innovations: \textit{(i) Multi-Level Skills Design}, which distills raw trajectories into three-tiered hierarchy of strategic plans, functional skills, and atomic skills; \textit{(ii) Iterative Skills Refinement}, which automatically revises skills based on execution feedback to continuously improve library quality; and \textit{(iii) Exploratory Skills Expansion}, which proactively generates and validates novel skills to expand coverage beyond seed training data. Using a strong backbone agent (GLM-4.6), we automatically build a reusable skill library and evaluate its transferability on challenging long-horizon, user-interactive benchmarks, including AppWorld, BFCL-v3, and $τ^2$-Bench. Experiments show that SkillKB consistently improves task success and execution efficiency when plugged into weaker base agents, highlighting the importance of structured, hierarchical experience representations for generalizable agent learning. Our code will be publicly available soon at https://github.com/zjunlp/SkillX. 🧠 核心术语库 [[即插即用技能知识库]] [[多级技能设计]] [[迭代技能优化]] [[探索性技能扩展]] [[轨迹蒸馏]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出SkillX自动化框架构建即插即用技能知识库，包含三大核心机制：1) 多级技能设计：将原始轨迹蒸馏为战略计划、功能技能、原子技能三层架构；2) 迭代技能优化：基于执行反馈自动修订技能以提升质量；3) 探索性技能扩展：主动生成并验证新技能以扩充覆盖面。利用强模型(GLM-4.6)构建技能库，并即插即用地迁移至弱模型以提升其任务成功率和执行效率。 💬 锐评 将经验显式表示为层次化技能库并跨模型复用的思路具有较高的工程落地价值，但“探索性技能扩展”若无严格的边界控制与验证机制，极易引入幻觉技能导致库污染。此外，高度依赖单一强模型(GLM-4.6)作为技能源，技能库的质量上限会被该模型的能力天花板锁死，且面对分布外(OOD)极端环境时的泛化可靠性仍需打问号。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: EffiSkill: Agent Skill Based Automated Code Efficiency Optimization
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该工作直击现有LLM优化方法缺乏可复用知识、泛化能力弱的痛点，创新性地将隐式的代码优化经验显式化为'技能'，推动Agent从'一次性改写'向'知识沉淀与复用'进化；但'无执行'策略虽提升了效率，却也切断了运行时反馈的纠错路径，对模型静态诊断能力提出了极高要求。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: EffiSkill: Agent Skill Based Automated Code Efficiency Optimization 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Zimu Wang, Yuling Shi, Mengfan Li, Zijun Liu, Jie M. Zhang, Chengcheng Wan, Xiaodong Gu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-03-29 20:09:57 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27850v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过构建包含算子与元策略的显式技能库，成功实现了代码效率优化的知识蒸馏与泛化应用，为Agent技能学习提供了新的范式参考。 📄 摘要： Code efficiency is a fundamental aspect of software quality, yet how to harness large language models (LLMs) to optimize programs remains challenging. Prior approaches have sought for one-shot rewriting, retrieved exemplars, or prompt-based search, but they do not explicitly distill reusable optimization knowledge, which limits generalization beyond individual instances.   In this paper, we present EffiSkill, a framework for code-efficiency optimization that builds a portable optimization toolbox for LLM-based agents. The key idea is to model recurring slow-to-fast transformations as reusable agent skills that capture both concrete transformation mechanisms and higher-level optimization strategies. EffiSkill adopts a two-stage design: Stage I mines Operator and Meta Skills from large-scale slow/fast program pairs to build a skill library; Stage II applies this library to unseen programs through execution-free diagnosis, skill retrieval, plan composition, and candidate generation, without runtime feedback.   Results on EffiBench-X show that EffiSkill achieves higher optimization success rates, improving over the strongest baseline by 3.69 to 12.52 percentage points across model and language settings. These findings suggest that mechanism-level skill reuse provides a useful foundation for execution-free code optimization, and that the resulting skill library can serve as a reusable resource for broader agent workflows. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Agent Skill]] [[Skill Library]] [[Operator Skills]] [[Meta Skills]] [[Execution-free Optimization]] [[Knowledge Distillation]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段从大规模慢/快程序对中挖掘'算子技能'与'元技能'构建可复用技能库；第二阶段通过无执行诊断、检索与规划，将技能库应用于新程序的自动化优化。 💬 锐评 该工作直击现有LLM优化方法缺乏可复用知识、泛化能力弱的痛点，创新性地将隐式的代码优化经验显式化为'技能'，推动Agent从'一次性改写'向'知识沉淀与复用'进化；但'无执行'策略虽提升了效率，却也切断了运行时反馈的纠错路径，对模型静态诊断能力提出了极高要求。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: SkillRL: Evolving Agents via Recursive Skill-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该研究直击当前 LLM Agent 记忆模块“存多读慢、冗余且低效”的痛点，不再满足于存储 Raw Trajectory，而是通过蒸馏将其升维为 Hierarchical Skill。其最具洞察力的创新在于“递归进化”，它打破了传统静态技能库的僵化，让经验库随策略成长而迭代，这标志着 Agent 从单纯的“经验检索者”向“终身学习者”范式转变的关键一步。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: SkillRL: Evolving Agents via Recursive Skill-Augmented Reinforcement Learning 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Peng Xia, Jianwen Chen, Hanyang Wang, Jiaqi Liu, Kaide Zeng, Yu Wang, Siwei Han, Yiyang Zhou, Xujiang Zhao, Haifeng Chen, Zeyu Zheng, Cihang Xie, Huaxiu Yao 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-02-09 03:17:17 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08234v1 🧾 一句话总结： SkillRL 通过自动技能发现与递归进化机制，成功将冗余的原始经验转化为高效、可进化的行为技能库，大幅提升了 LLM Agent 在复杂任务中的推理效率与泛化能力。 📄 摘要： Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown stunning results in complex tasks, yet they often operate in isolation, failing to learn from past experiences. Existing memory-based methods primarily store raw trajectories, which are often redundant and noise-heavy. This prevents agents from extracting high-level, reusable behavioral patterns that are essential for generalization. In this paper, we propose SkillRL, a framework that bridges the gap between raw experience and policy improvement through automatic skill discovery and recursive evolution. Our approach introduces an experience-based distillation mechanism to build a hierarchical skill library SkillBank, an adaptive retrieval strategy for general and task-specific heuristics, and a recursive evolution mechanism that allows the skill library to co-evolve with the agent's policy during reinforcement learning. These innovations significantly reduce the token footprint while enhancing reasoning utility. Experimental results on ALFWorld, WebShop and seven search-augmented tasks demonstrate that SkillRL achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming strong baselines over 15.3% and maintaining robustness as task complexity increases. Code is available at this https://github.com/aiming-lab/SkillRL. 🧠 核心术语库 [[SkillRL]] [[SkillBank]] [[Experience-based Distillation]] [[Recursive Evolution]] [[Adaptive Retrieval]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出 SkillRL 框架，旨在解决原始轨迹冗余和噪声问题。核心包含三个部分：一是基于经验的蒸馏机制，将原始轨迹转化为分层的技能库；二是自适应检索策略，用于匹配通用和任务特定的启发式规则；三是递归进化机制，使技能库与 Agent 策略在强化学习过程中协同进化，从而实现从原始经验到策略提升的闭环。 💬 锐评 该研究直击当前 LLM Agent 记忆模块“存多读慢、冗余且低效”的痛点，不再满足于存储 Raw Trajectory，而是通过蒸馏将其升维为 Hierarchical Skill。其最具洞察力的创新在于“递归进化”，它打破了传统静态技能库的僵化，让经验库随策略成长而迭代，这标志着 Agent 从单纯的“经验检索者”向“终身学习者”范式转变的关键一步。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该工作极具启发性，通过RL机制解决了技能库‘冷启动’和‘一致性’的痛点。顺序执行机制模拟了人类技能习得的递进过程，而技能集成奖励的设计确保了技能不仅可用，而且高效。对于希望Agent具备持续进化能力的团队，这是必读的范式参考。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving Agent with Skill Library 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Jiongxiao Wang, Qiaojing Yan, Yawei Wang, Yijun Tian, Soumya Smruti Mishra, Zhichao Xu, Megha Gandhi, Panpan Xu, Lin Lee Cheong 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-12-18 21:58:19 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.17102v2 🧾 一句话总结： SAGE通过RL驱动的顺序执行和技能集成奖励，赋能Agent实现自我进化与技能复用，在AppWorld上实现了准确率提升、交互步数减少和Token消耗降低的三重优化。 📄 摘要： Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex reasoning and multi-turn interactions but struggle to continuously improve and adapt when deployed in new environments. One promising approach is implementing skill libraries that allow agents to learn, validate, and apply new skills. However, current skill library approaches rely primarily on LLM prompting, making consistent skill library implementation challenging. To overcome these challenges, we propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based approach to enhance agents' self-improvement capabilities with a skill library. Specifically, we introduce Skill Augmented GRPO for self-Evolution (SAGE), a novel RL framework that systematically incorporates skills into learning. The framework's key component, Sequential Rollout, iteratively deploys agents across a chain of similar tasks for each rollout. As agents navigate through the task chain, skills generated from previous tasks accumulate in the library and become available for subsequent tasks. Additionally, the framework enhances skill generation and utilization through a Skill-integrated Reward that complements the original outcome-based rewards. Experimental results on AppWorld demonstrate that SAGE, when applied to supervised-finetuned model with expert experience, achieves 8.9% higher Scenario Goal Completion while requiring 26% fewer interaction steps and generating 59% fewer tokens, substantially outperforming existing approaches in both accuracy and efficiency. 🧠 核心术语库 [[SAGE (Skill Augmented GRPO for self-Evolution)]] [[Sequential Rollout (顺序执行)]] [[Skill-integrated Reward (技能集成奖励)]] [[Skill Library (技能库)]] 🔬 核心方法简述 SAGE框架利用‘顺序执行’在相似任务链上迭代rollout，结合‘技能集成奖励’来优化技能生成与利用，从而实现技能库的动态积累与复用。 💬 锐评 该工作极具启发性，通过RL机制解决了技能库‘冷启动’和‘一致性’的痛点。顺序执行机制模拟了人类技能习得的递进过程，而技能集成奖励的设计确保了技能不仅可用，而且高效。对于希望Agent具备持续进化能力的团队，这是必读的范式参考。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: Odyssey: Empowering Minecraft Agents with Open-World Skills
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 批判性锐评：虽然Odyssey在技能库和基准测试方面有所创新，但其对开放世界探索的局限性仍需进一步验证。例如，技能库是否足够覆盖所有游戏可能性？长期规划能力是否真正有效？此外，依赖维基数据集可能导致智能体缺乏对非结构化信息的处理能力。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: Odyssey: Empowering Minecraft Agents with Open-World Skills 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Shunyu Liu, Yaoru Li, Kongcheng Zhang, Zhenyu Cui, Wenkai Fang, Yuxuan Zheng, Tongya Zheng, Mingli Song 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-07-22 02:06:59 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.15325v3 🧾 一句话总结： 一句话价值总结：Odyssey通过构建技能库和微调LLM，提升了Minecraft中智能体的开放世界能力，但其在长期规划和泛化能力上仍面临挑战。 📄 摘要： Recent studies have delved into constructing generalist agents for open-world environments like Minecraft. Despite the encouraging results, existing efforts mainly focus on solving basic programmatic tasks, e.g., material collection and tool-crafting following the Minecraft tech-tree, treating the ObtainDiamond task as the ultimate goal. This limitation stems from the narrowly defined set of actions available to agents, requiring them to learn effective long-horizon strategies from scratch. Consequently, discovering diverse gameplay opportunities in the open world becomes challenging. In this work, we introduce Odyssey, a new framework that empowers Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents with open-world skills to explore the vast Minecraft world. Odyssey comprises three key parts: (1) An interactive agent with an open-world skill library that consists of 40 primitive skills and 183 compositional skills. (2) A fine-tuned LLaMA-3 model trained on a large question-answering dataset with 390k+ instruction entries derived from the Minecraft Wiki. (3) A new agent capability benchmark includes the long-term planning task, the dynamic-immediate planning task, and the autonomous exploration task. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed Odyssey framework can effectively evaluate different capabilities of LLM-based agents. Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: Agentic Skill Discovery
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 依赖LLM生成的任务提案可能存在语义偏差，强化学习的探索效率需进一步优化，且验证模型的泛化能力有待验证
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: Agentic Skill Discovery 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Xufeng Zhao, Cornelius Weber, Stefan Wermter 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-05-23 19:44:03 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.15019v2 🧾 一句话总结： 该研究开创性地通过LLM驱动的自主学习框架，实现了机器人技能库的零样本自组织演化 📄 摘要： Language-conditioned robotic skills make it possible to apply the high-level reasoning of Large Language Models (LLMs) to low-level robotic control. A remaining challenge is to acquire a diverse set of fundamental skills. Existing approaches either manually decompose a complex task into atomic robotic actions in a top-down fashion, or bootstrap as many combinations as possible in a bottom-up fashion to cover a wider range of task possibilities. These decompositions or combinations, however, require an initial skill library. For example, a ``grasping'' capability can never emerge from a skill library containing only diverse ``pushing'' skills. Existing skill discovery techniques with reinforcement learning acquire skills by an exhaustive exploration but often yield non-meaningful behaviors. In this study, we introduce a novel framework for skill discovery that is entirely driven by LLMs. The framework begins with an LLM generating task proposals based on the provided scene description and the robot's configurations, aiming to incrementally acquire new skills upon task completion. For each proposed task, a series of reinforcement learning processes are initiated, utilizing reward and success determination functions sampled by the LLM to develop the corresponding policy. The reliability and trustworthiness of learned behaviors are further ensured by an independent vision-language model. We show that starting with zero skill, the skill library emerges and expands to more and more meaningful and reliable skills, enabling the robot to efficiently further propose and complete advanced tasks. Project page: \url{https://agentic-skill-discovery.github.io}. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Language-conditioned robotic skills]] [[LLM-driven skill discovery]] [[Reinforcement Learning with LLM-sampled rewards]] [[Vision-Language Model for Validation]] [[Skill Library Evolution]] 🔬 核心方法简述 基于LLM生成任务提案，通过强化学习开发对应策略，结合独立视觉-语言模型验证可靠性，实现从零开始构建渐进式技能库 💬 锐评 依赖LLM生成的任务提案可能存在语义偏差，强化学习的探索效率需进一步优化，且验证模型的泛化能力有待验证 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: Bootstrap Your Own Skills: Learning to Solve New Tasks with Large Language Model Guidance
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该工作将LLM作为技能规划的引导者有一定新意，但核心问题仍显模糊：LLM如何判断"有意义技能"的具体依据？实验仅在模拟家庭环境评估，未见真实机器人实验；所谓"无监督"其实依赖LLM的隐式监督，实质是将人工设计prompt的工作转嫁给了LLG；与naive bootstrapping对比的提升幅度和鲁棒性存疑。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: Bootstrap Your Own Skills: Learning to Solve New Tasks with Large Language Model Guidance 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Jesse Zhang, Jiahui Zhang, Karl Pertsch, Ziyi Liu, Xiang Ren, Minsuk Chang, Shao-Hua Sun, Joseph J. Lim 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2023-10-16 02:43:47 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.10021v2 🧾 一句话总结： 提出利用LLM指导强化学习agent进行技能自举以零样本完成新长视野任务的新思路，是LLM+RL结合的有益探索，但离实际部署仍有距离。 📄 摘要： We propose BOSS, an approach that automatically learns to solve new long-horizon, complex, and meaningful tasks by growing a learned skill library with minimal supervision. Prior work in reinforcement learning require expert supervision, in the form of demonstrations or rich reward functions, to learn long-horizon tasks. Instead, our approach BOSS (BOotStrapping your own Skills) learns to accomplish new tasks by performing "skill bootstrapping," where an agent with a set of primitive skills interacts with the environment to practice new skills without receiving reward feedback for tasks outside of the initial skill set. This bootstrapping phase is guided by large language models (LLMs) that inform the agent of meaningful skills to chain together. Through this process, BOSS builds a wide range of complex and useful behaviors from a basic set of primitive skills. We demonstrate through experiments in realistic household environments that agents trained with our LLM-guided bootstrapping procedure outperform those trained with naive bootstrapping as well as prior unsupervised skill acquisition methods on zero-shot execution of unseen, long-horizon tasks in new environments. Website at clvrai.com/boss. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Skill bootstrapping（技能自举）]] [[Zero-shot execution（零样本执行）]] [[Long-horizon tasks（长视野任务）]] [[Unsupervised skill acquisition（无监督技能获取）]] [[Primitive skills（原始技能）]] [[LLM-guided skill chaining（LLM引导的技能链）]] 🔬 核心方法简述 BOSS方法通过"技能自举"机制学习新任务：给定一组原始技能，agent在 无外部奖励反馈的环境中自主探索实践新技能；LLM在 bootstrapping 阶段提供指导，告知agent哪些技能值得链接组合以完成有意义的长视野任务，从而从原始技能构建出复杂行为库。 💬 锐评 该工作将LLM作为技能规划的引导者有一定新意，但核心问题仍显模糊：LLM如何判断"有意义技能"的具体依据？实验仅在模拟家庭环境评估，未见真实机器人实验；所谓"无监督"其实依赖LLM的隐式监督，实质是将人工设计prompt的工作转嫁给了LLG；与naive bootstrapping对比的提升幅度和鲁棒性存疑。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.short_review: 论文不仅通过基准测试无情揭露了当前最强LLM在复杂推理任务中的脆弱性（仅39.6%步骤成功），更通过分阶段诊断精准定位了不同规模模型的性能瓶颈——小模型死在无法融合证据，大模型则卡在逻辑排序上，这种将评估从“只看结果”深化到“病灶分析”的做法，比单纯刷分更有建设性。
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.full_note: DiagChain: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Evidence-Grounded Attack Chain Reconstruction 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction 👤 作者： Xuyang Liu, Yibin Han, Zhenwei Zhang, Kai Chang, Zhiwei Xu, Tian Qiu, Weixian Deng, Jiabao Gao, Xiaolin Peng, Hai Wan, Xibin Zhao 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-04 12:43:47 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03591v1 🧾 一句话总结： 构建了首个针对网络安全攻击链重构的诊断基准DiagChain，通过分阶段评估揭示了LLM在证据整合与逻辑排序上的具体缺陷，为提升智能体推理能力提供了可操作的见解。 📄 摘要： Large Language Model (LLM) agents offer a promising approach to attack chain reconstruction by retrieving and interpreting heterogeneous telemetry to infer ordered attacker actions. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate final outputs or aggregate accuracy, providing limited insight into how errors arise and propagate across intermediate reasoning stages. We present DiagChain, a diagnostic benchmark for evidence-grounded attack chain reconstruction that enables stage-wise evaluation of LLM agents. DiagChain includes MAIN-69, a suite of 69 scenarios spanning multiple operating systems, evidence noise levels, and chain lengths. It further introduces Evidence-Centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation (ECRAG), which couples evidence retrieval with an evolving structured representation of the reconstructed chain. Five complementary metrics are introduced to assess distinct stages of the reconstruction process and support systematic failure diagnosis. Based on evaluations using 6 LLMs, DiagChain reveals that even the strongest configuration succeeds on only 39.6% of the 849 reference steps in MAIN-69. Our analysis further shows that smaller models struggle with the more basic task of incorporating retrieved evidence into their outputs, whereas larger models can proceed to later steps, where correctly ordering that evidence becomes the main bottleneck. These results validate the importance of diagnostic evaluation beyond end-to-end accuracy and provide actionable insights for improving evidence-grounded cybersecurity agents. 🧠 核心术语库 [[DiagChain]] [[MAIN-69]] [[Evidence-Grounded Attack Chain Reconstruction]] [[ECRAG]] [[Stage-wise Evaluation]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出了DiagChain诊断基准框架及包含69个场景的MAIN-69数据集；引入ECRAG（Evidence-Centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation）方法，将证据检索与重构链的结构化表示相结合；设计了5项互补指标以支持对重构过程的分阶段评估和故障诊断。 💬 锐评 论文不仅通过基准测试无情揭露了当前最强LLM在复杂推理任务中的脆弱性（仅39.6%步骤成功），更通过分阶段诊断精准定位了不同规模模型的性能瓶颈——小模型死在无法融合证据，大模型则卡在逻辑排序上，这种将评估从“只看结果”深化到“病灶分析”的做法，比单纯刷分更有建设性。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.title: EffiHolmes: Differential Profiling-Guided Repository Level Time Inefficiency Fix Localization
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.short_review: 作为冷启动阶段的奠基性工作，该论文精准切中了大型软件系统中“功能正确但性能低下”这一痛点，有效解决了传统测试和堆栈跟踪方法失效的问题。通过引入差分分析和领域指导推理，它克服了单次分析中的噪声干扰和语义差距。尽管基准测试尚处于起步阶段，但其提出的 RepoEffi-Bench 为该领域提供了首个标准化的评估环境。
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.full_note: EffiHolmes: Differential Profiling-Guided Repository Level Time Inefficiency Fix Localization 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction 👤 作者： Haowen Yang, Yun Peng, Zishuo Ding 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-04 12:26:59 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03558v1 🧾 一句话总结： EffiHolmes 是首个针对仓库级时间低效定位的 LLM 框架，通过差分分析和路径提取解决了功能正常代码的性能诊断难题，在 RepoEffi-Bench 上实现了显著优于现有基线的性能提升。 📄 摘要： Large software systems often suffer from time inefficiencies that cause excessive execution time despite functional correctness. Localizing their fix locations is difficult because, unlike functional bugs, they produce neither test failures nor stack-trace clues, making traditional and recent LLM-based fault localization methods unsuitable. Runtime profiling provides alternative evidence but faces three challenges in repository-level settings: single-run profiling cannot reliably distinguish inefficiency hotspots from execution noise; existing profilers struggle to extract relevant execution paths from extensive background execution; and a semantic gap remains between observed hotspots and actual fix locations. We propose EffiHolmes, an LLM-based framework for repository-level time inefficiency fix localization. EffiHolmes uses differential profiling under default and scaled workloads to identify inefficiency hotspots, extracts compact execution paths connecting these hotspots to the reported inefficient function, and employs domain-guided LLM reasoning to locate the underlying inefficiency logic. We also introduce RepoEffi-Bench, the first benchmark for repository-level inefficiency localization, containing 140 high-quality issues collected from popular Python repositories. Experiments show that EffiHolmes consistently outperforms state-of-the-art retrieval-, agent-, and profiling-based baselines, improving file-level Acc@3 by 4.29 percentage points with GPT-5.1 and function-level Acc@5 by 15.00 percentage points with qwen3-4b. It also remains robust across model capacities. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Differential Profiling]] [[Efficiency Hotspots]] [[Compact Execution Paths]] [[RepoEffi-Bench]] 🔬 核心方法简述 EffiHolmes 采用差分分析（在默认与扩展负载下运行）来识别低效热点，提取连接这些热点与目标函数的紧凑执行路径，并利用领域指导的 LLM 推理来定位底层低效逻辑，从而实现仓库级的时间低效定位。 💬 锐评 作为冷启动阶段的奠基性工作，该论文精准切中了大型软件系统中“功能正确但性能低下”这一痛点，有效解决了传统测试和堆栈跟踪方法失效的问题。通过引入差分分析和领域指导推理，它克服了单次分析中的噪声干扰和语义差距。尽管基准测试尚处于起步阶段，但其提出的 RepoEffi-Bench 为该领域提供了首个标准化的评估环境。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.title: Cooperative Coevolution for Resource-Constrained Agentic LLM Post-Training
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.short_review: 方法依赖子空间划分策略的有效性，可能面临维度灾难风险；未提及对超参数的敏感性分析；实验仅聚焦数学任务，需验证通用性；理论分析缺乏对内存节省与精度收益的量化关系证明。
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.full_note: Cooperative Coevolution for Resource-Constrained Agentic LLM Post-Training 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction 👤 作者： Zhiyuan Wang, Shengcai Liu, Jiahao Wu, Ning Lu, Hui Ouyang, Shaofeng Zhang, Haoze Lv, Ke Tang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 15:34:45 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02391v1 🧾 一句话总结： CoPES通过参数子空间协作进化，在资源受限场景下实现比标准ES高25%的验证准确率增益，同时将内存需求降低至传统方法的1/8。 📄 摘要： Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents produce long, multi-turn trajectories, making gradient-based post-training memory-intensive. Evolution strategies (ES) enable memory-efficient full-parameter post-training without backpropagation and can eventually match the performance of gradient-based reinforcement learning (RL). However, resource-constrained settings typically offer only a few GPUs, so the high GPU-hour requirements of ES translate into prohibitively long training times. To address this, we introduce Cooperative Parameter-subspace Evolution Strategy (CoPES), a cooperative coevolutionary method that decomposes the full parameter space into lower-dimensional subspaces and searches over them cooperatively to improve optimization efficiency. We post-train a Qwen3.5-4B tool-using agent for the math task and evaluate it on five benchmarks of varying difficulty. Under the GPU-hour budget of full-parameter GRPO's best validation checkpoint, CoPES recovers 92% of GRPO's validation-accuracy gain, versus 67% for standard ES, while its theoretical GPU memory requirement is less than one-eighth that of full-parameter GRPO. It consistently outperforms standard ES and LoRA-based GRPO on all evaluated pass@k metrics across the five benchmarks. Additional experiments further show the advantage of CoPES on the question-answering task. These results demonstrate an improved trade-off between memory requirements and training time for agentic LLM post-training under resource constraints. The code is open-sourced in https://github.com/MetaronWang/CoPES 🧠 核心术语库 [[Cooperative Coevolution]] [[Parameter-subspace Evolution Strategy]] [[Resource-constrained Settings]] [[Gradient-based Reinforcement Learning (RL)]] [[Evolution Strategies (ES)]] [[LoRA-based GRPO]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出Cooperative Parameter-subspace Evolution Strategy (CoPES)，通过将全参数空间分解为低维子空间并协作进化搜索，实现资源受限场景下高效参数优化。对比标准ES和LoRA-based GRPO，在相同GPU-hour预算下获得更优性能。 💬 锐评 方法依赖子空间划分策略的有效性，可能面临维度灾难风险；未提及对超参数的敏感性分析；实验仅聚焦数学任务，需验证通用性；理论分析缺乏对内存节省与精度收益的量化关系证明。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.title: SkillTrace: Traversing a Query-Skill Graph for Composable LLM Agents
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.short_review: 论文实验数据亮眼（ALFWorld 91.43%），但存在局限：仅基于摘要难以评判图构建的具体实现细节和消融实验；SkillsBench仅53.17%说明方法仍有提升空间；摘要未披露计算成本和推理时延，图方法可能引入额外复杂度；' compositional relations'的具体定义和如何自动获取依赖关系是黑箱。
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.full_note: SkillTrace: Traversing a Query-Skill Graph for Composable LLM Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction 👤 作者： Yue Yao, Shengyuan Wang, Xin Chen, Minke Zhang, Jia He, Bingjun Luo, Tom Gedeon 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 15:07:11 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02356v1 🧾 一句话总结： 将技能组合检索问题创新性地建模为三层图结构，通过语义层次化和依赖传播解决LLM agent的技能组合挑战，实验验证了方法的有效性与通用性，为可组合agent提供了新思路。 📄 摘要： Large language model agents increasingly solve complex tasks by composing reusable skills from a library. To address this, the key challenge is not merely to retrieve individually relevant skills, but to identify a complete and executable skill composition. In this paper, we argue that this problem can be solved in a graph with three levels: compositional relations among skill queries, similarity between queries and candidates in the skill library, and the dependencies among the selected candidates. We introduce SkillTrace, which organizes the user query into a semantic hierarchy, matches skill queries and candidates, and propagates over the skill dependencies. Experiments on SkillsBench and ALFWorld demonstrate that SkillTrace achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching a success rate of 53.17% on SkillsBench and 91.43% on ALFWorld. SkillTrace also delivers consistent improvements across different backbone language models, demonstrating the generality and robustness of graph-based skill retrieval. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Query-Skill Graph]] [[Skill Composition]] [[Semantic Hierarchy]] [[Dependency Propagation]] [[Reusable Skills Library]] 🔬 核心方法简述 SkillTrace将技能组合问题建模为三层图结构：(1)用户查询被组织为语义层次；(2)技能查询与技能库候选进行相似度匹配；(3)选中候选之间进行依赖关系传播。核心是通过图遍历找到 完整且可执行的技能组合路径。 💬 锐评 论文实验数据亮眼（ALFWorld 91.43%），但存在局限：仅基于摘要难以评判图构建的具体实现细节和消融实验；SkillsBench仅53.17%说明方法仍有提升空间；摘要未披露计算成本和推理时延，图方法可能引入额外复杂度；' compositional relations'的具体定义和如何自动获取依赖关系是黑箱。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.title: Harness-R1: Learning to Edit Executable Runtime Harnesses from Agent Failure Trajectories
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.short_review: 将Agent优化的焦点从单纯的模型权重微调转移到运行时框架的自动代码修补上，视角独特且极具工程落地价值。然而，引入一个9B规模的'工程师'模型去修补Runtime，其推理开销与目标Agent的执行开销相比是否具备性价比？且让模型在运行时直接生成并应用可执行补丁，面临极高的安全性与稳定性风险。此外，摘要提及的'co-evolving'实质上仍是交替优化而非真正的端到端联合优化。
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.full_note: Harness-R1: Learning to Edit Executable Runtime Harnesses from Agent Failure Trajectories 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction 👤 作者： Shuai Shao, Kangning Zhang, Qingyao Li, Shijian Wang, Hao Wang, Wenxiang Jiao, Yuan Lu, Yi Guo, Weiwen Liu, Weinan Zhang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 14:12:18 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02276v1 🧾 一句话总结： 提出Harness-R1，利用强化学习训练专门的'harness engineer'模型，基于目标Agent的失败轨迹自动编辑和优化可执行运行时框架，开辟了Agent环境工程自动进化的新范式。 📄 摘要： Agents built around large language models continually accumulate interaction trajectories during deployment, yet their behavior typically remains fixed. Beyond updating model weights, these trajectories can improve the agent harness that constructs context, mediates tools, validates actions, and recovers execution. We introduce Harness-R1, the first method, to our knowledge, that makes failure-conditioned, lifecycle-wide editing of an existing executable runtime a learned capability. It post-trains a dedicated harness engineer with online reinforcement learning so that its edits are optimized for the realized task success they produce, rather than proposed by a fixed editor. A separate 9B engineer converts batches of target-agent failures into validated executable patches; fresh same-batch reruns of the frozen target provide outcome rewards, so training updates only the engineer. Cold-start supervised fine-tuning initializes this editing policy, which is then trained online with group-relative policy optimization. Across WebShop, ALFWorld, and DBBench, Harness-R1 raises vanilla Qwen3.5-9B success from 44.3% to 53.6% (+9.3 percentage points). After direct target-agent fine-tuning, a target-specific engineer raises the average further from 59.2% to 64.2% (+5.0 points); because these gains hold both before and after fine-tuning the target, Harness-R1 points toward co-evolving the harness engineer and the target agent. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Runtime Harness]] [[Failure-Conditioned Editing]] [[Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)]] [[Outcome Reward]] [[Co-evolving]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出Harness-R1，通过监督微调（SFT）冷启动一个9B参数的'harness engineer'模型，随后利用在线强化学习（GRPO）进行训练。训练过程中目标Agent保持冻结，engineer接收目标Agent的失败轨迹并生成可验证的可执行harness补丁；补丁应用后，目标Agent在同批次任务上的重新运行成功率作为结果奖励信号，仅更新engineer模型参数，从而实现基于失败轨迹的运行时环境自动编辑与优化。 💬 锐评 将Agent优化的焦点从单纯的模型权重微调转移到运行时框架的自动代码修补上，视角独特且极具工程落地价值。然而，引入一个9B规模的'工程师'模型去修补Runtime，其推理开销与目标Agent的执行开销相比是否具备性价比？且让模型在运行时直接生成并应用可执行补丁，面临极高的安全性与稳定性风险。此外，摘要提及的'co-evolving'实质上仍是交替优化而非真正的端到端联合优化。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.title: Hybrid Analysis for Secure MCP Tool Use in LLM Agents
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.short_review: 该文精准切中了Agent生态发展的软肋——随着MCP成为事实标准，工具调用的安全性已成为比模型本身更紧迫的瓶颈。传统纯静态分析在面对间接提示注入或复杂工具链攻击时往往形同虚设，MTGuard通过引入动态分析，成功将软件安全领域的成熟范式迁移至Agent交互层，为构建可信Agent环境提供了关键的防御范式。
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.full_note: Hybrid Analysis for Secure MCP Tool Use in LLM Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction 👤 作者： Ping He, Yuexiang Xie, Yaliang Li, Shouling Ji 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-07-28 05:17:34 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25297v1 🧾 一句话总结： 针对LLM Agent中日益普及的MCP工具标准，首创动静结合的防御机制，有效解决了静态防御无法拦截运行时恶意行为的核心痛点。 📄 摘要： The rapid development of large language model (LLM) agents has enabled their broad adoption across diverse real-world tasks. To standardize interactions between LLM agents and external environments, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools have emerged as a de facto standard and have been widely integrated into these systems. However, the use of MCP tools also introduces new safety risks, as LLM agents can be induced to perform malicious or unauthorized actions. Although prior work has proposed defenses for securing tool use in LLM agents, most methods rely on static analysis, i.e., inspecting prompts and generated outputs, which limits the defense effectiveness and robustness. To address these limitations, we propose MTGuard, a hybrid analysis-based defense framework designed to safeguard the use of MCP tools in LLM agents by leveraging lifecycle-aware static-dynamic co-analysis. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that MTGuard effectively mitigates multiple categories of harmful tool use across different LLM agents while maintaining performance on benign user tasks. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Model Context Protocol (MCP)]] [[Hybrid Analysis]] [[Static-Dynamic Co-analysis]] [[LLM Agent Safety]] [[Tool Use Lifecycle]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出MTGuard防御框架，采用全生命周期感知的静态-动态协同分析方法，不仅检测提示词和输出（静态），还监控工具执行时的实际行为（动态），从而弥补纯静态分析在面对复杂攻击时的不足。 💬 锐评 该文精准切中了Agent生态发展的软肋——随着MCP成为事实标准，工具调用的安全性已成为比模型本身更紧迫的瓶颈。传统纯静态分析在面对间接提示注入或复杂工具链攻击时往往形同虚设，MTGuard通过引入动态分析，成功将软件安全领域的成熟范式迁移至Agent交互层，为构建可信Agent环境提供了关键的防御范式。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.short_review: 该综述精准击中了当前LLM Agent系统的痛点——仅靠最终答案准确率无法掩盖决策黑盒的不可解释性，尤其在涉及工具调用和长时记忆时风险剧增。文中试图将检索、工具、记忆等离散环节统一到“信任”框架下极具前瞻性，虽然构建完整的类型化溯源图在实际工程中可能面临计算与存储开销的挑战，但这无疑是Agent从玩具Demo迈向工业级可信系统的必经之路。
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.full_note: From Agent Traces to Trust: A Survey of Evidence Tracing and Execution Provenance in LLM Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction 👤 作者： Yiqi Wang, Jiaqi Zhang, Taotao Cai, Zirui Liu, Qingqiang Sun, Zequn Sun, Zhangkai Wu, Manqing Dong, Mingkai Zheng, Xuefei Yin, Yanming Zhu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-06-03 15:12:47 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04990v4 🧾 一句话总结： 确立了以执行溯源和证据追踪为核心的可信Agent理论框架，为解决复杂Agent行为不可解释、不可审计及难以恢复的问题提供了系统性图谱。 📄 摘要： Large language model (LLM)-based agents are evolving from passive text generators into autonomous systems capable of planning, tool use, retrieval, memory access, environmental interaction, and multi-agent collaboration. These capabilities expand agent autonomy, but also make agent behavior harder to verify, debug, and audit. Final-answer accuracy alone cannot explain how an output was produced, which evidence supported each claim, whether tool calls were justified, how memory influenced later decisions, or where failures originated. This survey examines evidence tracing and execution provenance as foundations for process-level accountability in trustworthy LLM agents. We define execution provenance as the typed graph of an agent execution and evidence tracing as its projection onto evidence-support relations. This perspective connects retrieval grounding, claim support, tool-use safety, memory lineage, observability, debugging, audit, and recovery within a unified framework. We introduce a taxonomy covering trace sources, evidence and execution units, provenance relations, tracing granularity and timing, representation forms, and trust functions. We then review key methodological directions, including provenance representation, evidence attribution, tool-use provenance, runtime guardrails, provenance-bearing memory, observability, and failure diagnosis. Finally, we discuss benchmarks, datasets, metrics, and open challenges for building provenance-aware, auditable, and recoverable agent systems. 🧠 核心术语库 [[执行溯源]] [[证据追踪]] [[过程级问责制]] [[记忆谱系]] [[可观测性]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出统一框架，定义“执行溯源”为类型化执行图，“证据追踪”为证据支持关系的投影；通过分类体系梳理轨迹来源、单元、关系、粒度及表现形式，涵盖从检索、工具到记忆谱系的全过程。 💬 锐评 该综述精准击中了当前LLM Agent系统的痛点——仅靠最终答案准确率无法掩盖决策黑盒的不可解释性，尤其在涉及工具调用和长时记忆时风险剧增。文中试图将检索、工具、记忆等离散环节统一到“信任”框架下极具前瞻性，虽然构建完整的类型化溯源图在实际工程中可能面临计算与存储开销的挑战，但这无疑是Agent从玩具Demo迈向工业级可信系统的必经之路。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.short_review: 填补了现有LLM代理评估中忽视时间维度（尤其是延迟）的空白，将关注点从单纯的工具调用能力提升至任务间的协调与时间管理。实验揭示了当前模型在处理并发任务和依赖跟踪时的显著短板，为设计具备更强时间推理能力的Agent提供了重要方向。
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.full_note: AsyncTool: Evaluating the Asynchronous Function Calling Capability under Multi-Task Scenarios 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction 👤 作者： Kou Shi, Ziao Zhang, Shiting Huang, Avery Nie, Zhen Fang, Qiuchen Wang, Lin Chen, Huaian Chen, Zehui Chen, Feng Zhao 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-05-27 05:36:35 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27995v2 🧾 一句话总结： 通过引入异步延迟和多任务干扰，构建了评估LLM代理在等待工具响应期间进行任务协调与状态管理能力的基准测试。 📄 摘要： Large language model (LLM)-based agents have shown strong capabilities in using external tools to solve complex tasks. However, existing evaluations often overlook the temporal dimension of tool use, especially the impact of tool response latency, and are usually limited to single-task settings. In real-world applications, multiple tasks often need to be executed concurrently, and overall efficiency depends on whether an agent can use idle time while waiting for tool responses. We refer to this capability as asynchronous tool calling. To evaluate it, we propose AsyncTool, a benchmark for assessing LLM-based agents in interactive multi-task tool-use environments with delayed tool feedback. AsyncTool presents multiple heterogeneous tasks simultaneously and simulates realistic tool response latency during execution. Using a hybrid data evolution strategy, we construct a diverse asynchronous multitasking dataset that covers multiple scenarios and tool-use patterns. We evaluate models at the step, sub-task, and task levels, and introduce efficiency-oriented metrics to measure task coordination and completion efficiency. Extensive experiments show that delayed tool feedback poses substantial challenges to current agents and leads to clear performance degradation. Models that better coordinate task switching, dependency tracking, and state maintenance achieve stronger performance on AsyncTool. Our analysis identifies key failure modes of current tool-using agents and provides practical insights for designing future systems with stronger temporal reasoning and coordination capabilities. 🧠 核心术语库 [[异步工具调用]] [[工具响应延迟]] [[多任务并发]] [[混合数据进化策略]] [[任务协调与状态维护]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出了AsyncTool基准测试，通过模拟真实的工具响应延迟和多任务并发环境，利用混合数据进化策略构建多样化数据集。评估在步骤、子任务及任务层面进行，引入效率导向的指标来衡量任务协调与完成能力。 💬 锐评 填补了现有LLM代理评估中忽视时间维度（尤其是延迟）的空白，将关注点从单纯的工具调用能力提升至任务间的协调与时间管理。实验揭示了当前模型在处理并发任务和依赖跟踪时的显著短板，为设计具备更强时间推理能力的Agent提供了重要方向。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.short_review: 该方法有效解决了现有政策引导方式缺乏执行保证的问题，但依赖于人工翻译将政策转化为形式逻辑，可能存在效率、成本和准确性问题，且未提及如何处理动态变化的政策环境。
Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.full_note: Solver-Aided Verification of Policy Compliance in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction 👤 作者： Cailin Winston, Claris Winston, René Just 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-03-20 19:25:43 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20449v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过SMT求解器实时验证TaLLM工具调用是否符合形式化政策约束，提升了政策合规性和可靠性。 📄 摘要： Tool-augmented Large Language Models (TaLLMs) extend LLMs with the ability to invoke external tools, enabling them to interact with real-world environments. However, a major limitation in deploying TaLLMs in sensitive applications such as customer service and business process automation is a lack of reliable compliance with domain-specific operational policies regarding tool-use and agent behavior. Current approaches merely steer LLMs to adhere to policies by including policy descriptions in the LLM context, but these provide no guarantees that policy violations will be prevented. In this paper, we introduce an SMT solver-aided framework to enforce tool-use policy compliance in TaLLM agents. Specifically, we use an LLM-assisted, human-guided approach to translate natural-language-specified tool-use policies into formal logic (SMT-LIB-2.0) constraints over agent-observable state and tool arguments. At runtime, planned tool calls are intercepted and checked against the constraints using the Z3 solver as a pre-condition to the tool call. Tool invocations that violate the policy are blocked. We evaluated on the TauBench benchmark and demonstrate that solver-aided policy checking reduces policy violations while maintaining overall task accuracy. These results suggest that integrating formal reasoning into TaLLM execution can improve tool-call policy compliance and overall reliability. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Tool-Augmented Large Language Models (TaLLMs)]] [[Solver-Aided Verification]] [[SMT-LIB-2.0 constraints]] [[Policy compliance enforcement]] [[Z3 solver]] 🔬 核心方法简述 利用SMT求解器（如Z3）在TaLLM执行时实时检查工具调用是否符合预定义的正式逻辑约束，约束由自然语言政策通过LLM辅助人工翻译生成。 💬 锐评 该方法有效解决了现有政策引导方式缺乏执行保证的问题，但依赖于人工翻译将政策转化为形式逻辑，可能存在效率、成本和准确性问题，且未提及如何处理动态变化的政策环境。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.full_note: TUMIX: Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling with Tool-Use Mixture 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction 👤 作者： Yongchao Chen, Jiefeng Chen, Rui Meng, Ji Yin, Na Li, Chuchu Fan, Chi Wang, Tomas Pfister, Jinsung Yoon 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-09-30 19:19:56 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01279v1 🧾 一句话总结： TUMIX通过多智能体异构协作与动态优化机制，实现了工具使用效率与推理成本的平衡突破。 📄 摘要： While integrating tools like Code Interpreter and Search has significantly enhanced Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning in models like ChatGPT Agent and Gemini-Pro, practical guidance on optimal tool use is lacking. The core challenge is effectively combining textual reasoning, coding, and search for diverse questions. In this paper, we propose Tool-Use Mixture (TUMIX), an ensemble framework that runs multiple agents in parallel, each employing distinct tool-use strategies and answer paths. Agents in TUMIX iteratively share and refine responses based on the question and previous answers. In experiments, TUMIX achieves significant gains over state-of-the-art tool-augmented and test-time scaling methods, delivering an average accuracy improvement of up to 3.55% over the best baseline on Gemini-2.5-Pro and Gemini-2.5-Flash across key reasoning benchmarks, with near-equal inference costs. We find that agent diversity and quality are crucial and can be enhanced by using LLMs to auto-optimize agent designs. Furthermore, TUMIX can halt refinement upon reaching sufficient confidence, preserving performance at only 49% of the inference cost. Further scaling can achieve higher performance, albeit at a greater cost. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Tool-Use Mixture (TUMIX)]] [[Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling]] [[Ensemble Framework]] [[Agent Diversity and Quality]] [[Dynamic Response Refinement]] 🔬 核心方法简述 TUMIX通过并行运行多个具有不同工具使用策略的智能体，结合迭代响应共享与优化机制，实现多工具协同推理。核心框架包含：1) 多智能体异构策略设计 2) 动态响应迭代优化 3) 自动化智能体配置优化 💬 锐评 该方法过度依赖LLM的自动优化能力，可能产生策略冗余问题。停止优化的置信度阈值设定存在主观性，且未公开具体优化算法细节。实验数据仅展示单模型表现，缺乏跨模型泛化能力验证。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction.full_note: Generalizable End-to-End Tool-Use RL with Synthetic CodeGym 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Tool_Environment_Interaction 👤 作者： Weihua Du, Hailei Gong, Zhan Ling, Kang Liu, Lingfeng Shen, Xuesong Yao, Yufei Xu, Dingyuan Shi, Yiming Yang, Jiecao Chen 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-09-22 03:03:56 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.17325v2 🧾 一句话总结： 本文提出的CodeGym框架以编程题为基底构建可验证的多轮工具使用强化学习环境，显著提升了LLM agent的工具使用分布外泛化能力，为通用工具使用agent的可扩展训练提供了可行路径 📄 摘要： Tool-augmented large language models (LLMs), hereafter LLM agents, leverage external tools to solve diverse tasks and interface with the real world. However, current training practices largely rely on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) over static trajectories or reinforcement learning (RL) on narrow tasks, which generalize poorly beyond development settings and lead to brittleness with new tools and unseen workflows. Because code execution reflects many structural patterns of real-world workflows, we use coding problems as a structured substrate to build tool-use agent training environments with diverse task configurations. To this end, we introduce CodeGym, a scalable framework that synthesizes diverse, verifiable, and controllable multi-turn tool-use environments for agent RL, enabling LLM agents to explore and master various workflows actively. CodeGym converts static coding problems into interactive environments by extracting atomic functions or logic into callable tools, yielding verifiable tasks that span various tool-execution workflows. Models of varying sizes and chain-of-thought configurations trained in CodeGym exhibit consistent out-of-distribution generalizability; for example, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct achieves an absolute accuracy gain of 8.7 points on the OOD benchmark $τ$-Bench. These results highlight CodeGym as a step toward scalable general-purpose RL environments for training tool-use behaviors that align with real-world agent workflows. 🧠 核心术语库 [[LLM agents（工具增强大语言模型）]] [[CodeGym合成训练框架]] [[多轮工具使用（multi-turn tool-use）]] [[分布外泛化（OOD generalizability）]] [[τ-Bench评测基准]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出可扩展的CodeGym框架，将静态编程题转化为多轮工具使用的交互式强化学习环境：提取编程题中的原子函数/逻辑封装为可调用工具，生成覆盖多种工具执行流程的可验证任务，供不同规模LLM进行强化学习训练以掌握通用工具使用workflow 💬 锐评 该工作的场景适配性存在明显局限：训练基底仅覆盖代码类任务，工具类型仅为代码相关原子函数，与真实世界多元工具的场景gap较大，泛化性提升的有效范围可能仅局限于结构化任务；且合成环境的任务逻辑由预设编程题转化而来，无法覆盖真实工具使用的长尾、非标准化workflow，agent习得行为的可迁移性待验证 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。
